enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping restlessly, waking briefly several times with mild chronic pain and stress
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Turn onto side. Open eyes briefly. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto back. Open eyes. Shift legs. Close eyes. Turn onto side again.

enriched_activities.activity: Slow morning start: lying in bed, checking phone, scrolling Instagram and Messenger
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pick up phone from bedside table. Press home button. Swipe screen. Open Instagram. Scroll through feed. Tap on post. Scroll more. Open Messenger. Read messages. Type reply. Send. Put down phone. Rub eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing and taking daily medication (after Member 4's 07:00-07:30 bathroom slot; before Member 2's 08:30 bathroom slot)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Walk to sink. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Take medication. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a slow breakfast, boiling the kettle for herbal tea, no caffeine (after Member 4 finishes in the kitchen; before Member 2's 08:50 breakfast)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Pick up frying pan. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil. Crack eggs. Stir. Toast bread. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat with fork. Boil kettle. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting the desk and papers in a chaotic-tidiness way and planning the research day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Pick up papers. Sort into piles. Open drawer. Place papers in drawer. Pick up pen. Write notes. Open planner. Write tasks. Close planner. Put pen down.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD work: drafting a systematic review chapter on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open Word document. Type text. Scroll. Read. Type more. Highlight text. Delete. Type. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Gentle stretching and mobility break for chronic pain and mobility limitation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Stand behind couch. Raise arms. Stretch. Bend forward. Hold. Stand up. Twist torso. Reach arms. Sit on floor. Stretch legs. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: PhD work: analysing public health data and organising references on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open laptop. Open statistical software. Load dataset. Run descriptive statistics. Run regression. Save output. Open reference manager. Search for article. Add citation. Format bibliography. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch, sharing the kitchen and joining Member 1 and Member 2 during their lunch period
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Cook food. Stir. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Talk to Member 1 and Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the couch with the TV on quietly, overlapping with Member 1's short break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Lower volume. Lean back. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing supervision notes and preparing for the online PhD supervision meeting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open notebook. Read notes. Highlight key points. Open laptop. Open meeting link. Test camera. Test microphone. Adjust headset.

enriched_activities.activity: Online PhD supervision meeting with the research team over video call
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Join video call. Greet team. Share screen. Discuss chapter. Take notes. Nod. Speak. Listen. Stop sharing. End call.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing and editing thesis sections on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open thesis document. Type text. Edit sentences. Delete paragraph. Insert citation. Save document. Scroll. Read. Type more.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon snack and herbal tea break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cupboard. Take out snack. Open fridge. Take out milk. Pour milk into glass. Boil kettle. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat snack. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Household management: paying bills by mobile wallet, updating the support-shift roster, checking whether today's rostered shift was cancelled by the lockdown, and logging maintenance tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Pick up phone. Open mobile wallet app. Pay bills. Open calendar app. Update support-shift roster. Open email. Check for shift cancellation. Open notes app. Log maintenance tasks. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 1 and Member 2, sharing the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Stir. Talk to Member 1 and Member 2. Taste food. Turn off stove. Put food in serving dish.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner together with Member 1 and Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Serve food onto plate. Pick up fork. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Talk to Member 1 and Member 2. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down kitchen surfaces together with Member 1 and Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at sink. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash dish. Rinse dish. Place in drying rack. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wring cloth. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining the structured online group video call with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Open laptop. Join video call. Greet friends. Talk. Listen. Laugh. Share screen. Stop sharing. Leave call.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and taking night medication (after Member 1's 19:45-20:15 bathroom laundry; before Member 4's 21:00 shower)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up medication bottle. Open cap. Take pill. Swallow. Close cap. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Rejoining the structured online group video call with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Rejoin video call. Greet friends. Talk. Listen. Nod. Leave call.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check notifications. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down: reading, setting out tomorrow's things, and switching off the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read. Close book. Stand up. Pick out clothes. Place on chair. Pick up phone. Turn off phone. Plug in charger. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Turn onto side. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
